name: document-editor
description: Office document editing — fill PDF AcroForm/XFA fields, overlay text on flat PDFs, read/validate/diff DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, and fill DOCX mail-merge templates. Preserves the original document instead of converting it (no PDF->Word->PDF round-trips).

auth.hint: Operates on local file paths only -- no credentials needed. Requires office-oxide-mcp to be built once via `cargo install --git https://github.com/Aimino-Tech/opendocswork-mcp` (see README.md); this is a one-time machine setup step, not something this plugin installs automatically.
